changelog:
# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️
```- KO Royale has been swapped to its own settings page, including a new option to customize the lap counter multiplier individually rather than being dependant on the balloon count.
- In friend rooms, the host's Friend Room settings will be shown before voting, as well as their Knockout and OTT settings if enabled.
- The hosts's Custom Items will no longer be shown upon froom start if Online TT is enabled.
- New custom character slots no longer require an allkart szs archive to function.
- Online lobbies that have above a 40k VR difference than your local player will now be deprioritized.
- Removed the lowered Kart Velocity Prediction patch.
- Final Lap BRSTM's will now be able to play through My Stuff again, now renamed to X_final.brstm's for the retro brstms. Vanilla game brstms remain unchanged.
- Online room's average VR will be displayed on the VR screen during voting.
- Pressing B while connecting to RWFC will now just send you back to the title screen instead of giving an error.
- Code.pul's commit hash will now be displayed on the top left of the license screen.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜
```- Fixed an issue where exiting the WFC sections would randomly cause a game freeze.
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to stutter for a split second when changing BRSTMs when using the Retro Rewind channel.
- Fixed an issue where the SW2 Rainbow Road music reset would still apply, even when CT Music was disabled.
- Fixed an issue known as the phantom racer bug, where players in the lobby could appear as disconnected with 100 VR for specific non host players.
- Fixed an issue that caused the custom character driver models to be the default character model for the non previously selected characters during voting.
- Fixed an issue with KO mode where players that disconnected on elimination races could still survive the round, causing another player to get eliminated.
- Fixed an issue where the award ceremony would sometimes cause the game to randomly freeze.
- Fixed an issue where conditional item and enemy routes would be based on the player in first place rather than the actual player id.
- Fixed an issue where large modpacks wouldnt fully load in with Patches.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements have been addressed.
- Took Im "67" Zeraora out back.```

Thanks for being so patient with the server team while they have been working so hard to try and keep the servers as stable as possible! Please feel free to support **__Jacherr__** and **__ppeb__** in <#1369832254062461029> for that hard work with this!
Alongside this, since this is a major update, there will be a 1.5x VR mutliplier for 3 days! Have fun!
As always, please report any and all bugs into <#1265514050335412310>!

Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
